verdict.line: You lose if you let Yorick wall you in after level 3; you win if you chain Q into W before his Dark Procession is up.

brief.thesis: Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) stun and W (Frenzied Maul) on-hit recast give him a faster, harder all-in than anything Yorick has before level 3, and the 53.6% win rate over 1139 games with a solo-kill edge confirms it. The one structural threat is Yorick's W (Dark Procession) wall, which can trap Volibear mid-trade once it comes online - avoid fighting in chokepoints after level 3.

theirWindow.what: Yorick can drop Dark Procession to wall you off from your jungler or lane partner and free-hit you while you're boxed in. Don't commit extended trades next to walls or river chokes once he has the point in W.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Last Rites) and E (Mourning Mist) both down
yourWindow.what: Without Last Rites he has no bonus damage or self-heal, and without Mourning Mist he has no armor shred or slow to kite you. Walk up and chain Q into W-W for the stun-into-double-hit all-in.

powerCurve.note: Q stun threatens before his W exists

start.why: The 56.1% win rate across 1082 games (75% pick rate) reflects sustain through Yorick's Mourning Mist poke while you look for level 2-3 all-ins.

boots.why: 51.5% win rate over 701 games; Yorick's autos and Mist Walker swarms are physical, so the flat reduction blunts his poke-and-swarm pattern better than magic resist boots.

core.why: First item on the 53.8% win rate path (145 games), builds toward the attack speed scaling that fuels your W-recast trades.
Second item on the same line, pushes attack speed further so passive stacks and double-W procs come online faster in extended skirmishes.
Closes out the 53.8% path with healing amplification, which matters since your W-recast already heals you back in trades.

situational.when: yorick or his team is stacking lifesteal to offset your sustained W pressure
you're ahead and need to clear Mist Walkers and push waves faster between skirmishes
the lane turns into a prolonged poke war and you need extra sustain and range on your all-in

runes.keystoneWhy: Volibear's passive already grants attack speed on attacks and abilities, so Lethal Tempo compounds that ramp and makes the W-Q-W trade pattern hit harder the longer a fight goes.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite runs a 55.2% win rate at 79.1% pick rate and matches the data's solo-kill advantage - Ignite closes out all-ins before Yorick's Q (Last Rites) heal can save him.

playing.title: Open trades with Q into W
playing.detail: Thundering Smash's stun (12-10s cooldown as it ranks up) locks Yorick down for a guaranteed Frenzied Maul; recast W on the same mark immediately for the bonus damage and heal.

playing.title: Use E to contest lane at range
playing.detail: Sky Splitter reaches 1200 range and slows on hit - throw it to zone Yorick off minions or farm, and stand in the blast yourself for the shield when you're committing to a trade.

playing.title: Don't fight next to his W wall
playing.detail: After level 3, Dark Procession can box you into a corner away from help. Pull trades toward open lane or your own jungle side instead of river chokes.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown for all-ins
playing.detail: Last Rites drops from 6s to 4s cooldown with ranks, but right after he uses it he has no bonus damage or sustain for several seconds - that's your best all-in window.

playing.title: Save R for a decisive engage
playing.detail: Stormbringer's 160-110s cooldown and tower-disable make it a lane-defining play - leap in when his Maiden (R) isn't up yet to deny the fair fight entirely.

playing.title: Clear Mist Walkers before extended skirmishes
playing.detail: Yorick's passive swarms you with Walkers in longer fights; kill them quickly or disengage rather than let them chip you down while you focus Yorick.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoners, and all win rates are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Pressure Yorick during early game to gain lane control. Use [E] to contest lane and, after reaching level 3, be careful of being trapped inside (W).
